# workflows.WorkflowEvent

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A progress event of a workflow run, streamed as server-sent events.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `workflows.WorkflowEvent` |
| Kind | `event` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.workflow-run.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | yes | `none` | Position in the run's stream; the SSE `id`, used by `Last-Event-Id`. |  |
| `occurredAt` | yes | `none` | When the event was emitted (UTC). |  |
| `output` | no | `personal` | Step output, redacted by the workflow schema's pii meta. |  |
| `status` | yes | `none` | Step or run status carried by the event. |  |

| `type` | yes | `none` | Mastra event type. |  |
